task: G1-D simplified gripper pours ball from beaker into conical flask
model_limitations: G1-D URDF kinematics and inertias; missing robot mesh and robot link collision geometry; approximate gripper and vessels; fixed-base with gravity compensation; not hardware or VLA
success_definition: ball center crosses downward through flask mouth with radius clearance, finishes within inner cone at z 9–111 mm with velocity below 0.08 m/s
methods: smoothing=joint target filtering; geometry=larger object disturbance penalty during CEM; feedback=uses observed beaker position at grasp planning; all use same IK and grasp CEM; full uses CEM to optimize the pour target with complete future physics rollouts from the post-lift simulator state
